title: Loops
explanation: A for loop repeats a block of code a set number of times: for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { ... } runs with i = 0,1,2,3,4.
A while loop repeats as long as a condition stays true -- useful when you don't know the count in advance.
Loops are what make lesson 9's capstone possible: a five-line for loop can place hundreds of blocks. Try changing the loop bound below.
